reviews.title: Helps Me Tremendously
reviews.text:
I love this app.  As an ADHD brain, I really thrive on seeing the wins visually and getting to mark off a A+ day at the end of a long day is so rewarding.  Also super valuable to see the zoomed-out perspective as I had fallen off an important habit recently which felt like was only a week or two but the graphic doesn’t lie, I had managed to fall off for over a month.  There are a ton of customizations and features I have yet to use, but the habit tracker alone is amazing, I signed up for life!

Now I am combining this awesome tool with an accountability coach who checks in with me several times per day and getting so much accomplished.  Thanks Sebastian!

reviews.title: Simplicity
reviews.text: I've tried several habit tracking apps but this was the one I decided to purchase and use for almost 6 months atp. It's by far the most simplistic of the apps in its category, but that's what's drawn me to it and kept me in it. If I do the thing, it's easy to open the app and quickly mark it. If I need to do it multiple times a day, I set it up in the advanced options. I don't care much about the analytics of my habits but I really appreciate the different week, month, ytd viewing options. I think some improvements could be made with managing categories/labels, but anything else would generally take away from the minimalism of habitkit that i so deeply appreciate. It's been such a help for my mental health. Thank you!

reviews.title: Absolutely Love!
reviews.text: I love this app for tracking my habits! I’ve tried other apps and none of them were as good as this one. I like that I can choose a dark background and because of all the bright colors, it looks beautiful. I have the PRO version and o definitely think it’s worth the money; and it’s not expensive at all. I can track as many habits as I want to, and I can archive them when I want to stop tracking them (but it doesn’t delete them so I can “unarchive”them if I want to start tracking that habit again. I would like to suggest a couple of things that I think could make it better…first, I’d love to be able to set an alarm for my habits to remind me to do some of them. I’d also like to have a bigger color selection to choose from. The colors it has are beautiful and vibrant but I’d just like to add some more shades (because I track a lot of habits). I love the icons too, and the fact that I can reorder my habits at any time. All in all, it’s a fantastic app and I use it everyday! I’d definitely recommend for EVERYONE to get the pro version, and start tracking your habits! I’ve gotten a lot more consistent since I started using this app!

reviews.title: Best tracker out there
reviews.text:
Hands down one of the best habit trackers that I’ve found out there. The user interface is very intuitive and easy to use. It has absolutely everything I was looking for.
1. Ability to set daily, weekly or monthly goals.
2. Ability to create a goal that requires multiple completions to count toward a streak (i.e. taking meds—you can create two instances that go toward one goal).
3. Reminders that you can create to help you remember to complete your goal. Let’s face it some of us get busy and lose track of things we want to do during the day and this helps immensely.

These functions are in the pro version which is completely worth it, without a doubt.

reviews.title: Almost perfect - Few updates needed
reviews.text: I first downloaded HabitKit in the ending of March 2025. I bought the lifetime premium version. When I first downloaded the app, it didn't have an option for putting your own emojis for habits, which was really frustrating. I'm very happy that they finally put an emoji update. I was tired of using a dog bone for my seafood habit. My issue with the new update is that you can't change the skin color of the emojis. It's also disappointing that you can't choose a set of Crayola like colors for your habits including brown, instead of the preset pastel colors that is given. No true red or solid purples just a pastel palette for everything... I also think that the counter for 1, 5, 10 , 15 shouldn't be there. I think that instead the only option should be to set your own number of "Pages read" for each habit. It would look much better for the eyes that way. Or at least give the option to turn it off and only have your own preset number. I also think that the HabitKit wrapped should be worded better and upgraded. Besides those things, this is a decent app for habit tracking. I do also believe having a bad habit tracker section or page would be great, and helpful for separation of good and bad habits. Plus not being able to sync to iCloud is hella wack. I can only give 2 stars because I know it could be better.

reviews.title: The Perfect App For What I Needed
reviews.text:
This app on my phone has been insanely helpful and so easy to use. I can track anything going on in my life and then easily look back over the history of my habit. Things like how frequently I’m vacuuming or if I took my medication each day or week. Every time I login and track my habits it also reminds me of things I might not have done yet like…oh I haven’t done that thing yet today. So I often get up to start or finish something because I see that it isn’t checked off for the day. 

What makes this app better than others I was looking at is that I’m 100% choosing my own categories and specific tasks. So my weird and wonderful lists are tailored perfectly to me, and there isn’t anything extraneous. 

The only complaint I have is that the data is only on your device. So I can see and use it on my phone but I can’t pull it up on my tablet or computer. I reached out to the developers and they say they hope to change this in the future. So fingers crossed, this app could get even better.
